question: Which final-round candidates have not had a call from us in the last 7 days?
sql: SELECT c.name AS candidate, cl.name AS client, r.title AS role, a.stage_updated AS stage_updated, substr(a.next_interview_at,1,16) AS next_interview, (SELECT MAX(act.at) FROM activities act WHERE act.candidate_id = c.id AND act.kind = 'call') AS last_call, co.name AS consultant FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = r.client_id LEFT JOIN consultants co ON co.id = c.consultant_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND a.stage = 'final_round' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities act WHERE act.candidate_id = c.id AND act.kind = 'call' AND act.at >= date('2026-11-25','-7 day')) ORDER BY last_call IS NOT NULL, last_call ASC, c.name LIMIT 200
answer: Only Mei Lin Tan, who is at final round for the Quantitative Researcher, Systematic Equities role at Fernhallow Capital, has not had a call in the last 7 days. Her last call was on 2026-11-10 with consultant Hannah Pryce, and no next interview is booked.

meta.note: Active applications at final_round where the candidate has no logged call (activities.kind='call') dated 2026-11-18 or later; showing their last call date, oldest first.
